title: Decision Table: Schedule-Check Charge on Restored Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Certificates
content:
When a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate is restored by a reinstatement filing, the restoration schedule-check charge counts the vehicle additions, vehicle replacements, vehicle removals and garaging changes recorded on the named insured's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy records within the past month.

| Such endorsements recorded within the past month | Restoration schedule-check charge |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 6.00 |
| Exactly one | 3.00 |
| None | Nothing |

## What is counted

- **Kinds:** vehicle added, vehicle replaced, vehicle removed and garaging change endorsements. Other endorsements (drivers, coverages, lienholders and the like) are not counted.
- **Policies:** every policy of the named insured, not only the certified policy.
- **Window:** a one-month window covers the endorsements whose recorded date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the recorded date to today.

## Hypothetical cases (today 20 August)

| Endorsements recorded | Count in window | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Vehicle replaced, recorded 5 August; garaging change, recorded 18 August | 2 | 6.00 |
| Vehicle added, recorded 21 July | 1 | 3.00 |
| Vehicle removed, recorded 20 July | 0 (one whole month has passed) | Nothing |
| Driver added, recorded 10 August | 0 (not a counted kind) | Nothing |
